title: KV-cache drift resync and console gauge-flapping during autoscaler churn
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Following an autoscaler event that scaled down several Dedicated GPU pools, multiple customers reported missing dashboard series and intermittent trace gaps. Root cause analysis points to KV-cache sync drift between the runtime and ingestion pipeline which caused short-lived metric silent periods and inconsistent metric aggregation windows in the Console. This ticket implements an immediate resync + guardrails and long-term fixes to prevent recurrence.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger scale-down of a Dedicated node group (simulate preemptible or maintenance event)
2) Send 1k short-lived inference requests with prefix caching enabled
3) Observe Console metric window: some per-route gauges go to zero for 30-90s; traces show KV cache keys present in runtime but absent in ingestion join keys
4) Recreate with autoscaler churn frequency >= 1/min to reproduce flapping
root_cause: KV-cache invalidation messages were dropped during a burst of control-plane updates caused by autoscaler churn. The ingestion pipeline uses a join on cache keys to reconstruct metric envelopes; dropped invalidations left stale entries and short-lived tombstones which the Console's aggregation window interpreted as absence of series. Additionally, a race in the runtime's cache-per-tenant flush meant split-second inconsistencies between token-level counters and exported metrics.
mitigation:
1) Emergency resync job that recomputes current KV-cache index from runtime state and backfills missing cache keys into the ingestion pipeline (hotfix deployed to staging and then to affected regions).
2) Short-term: increase retry window for cache invalidation producer and hold aggregation window to 120s during detected autoscaler events.
3) Notify impacted customers and surface a temporary Dashboard badge describing missing-data window.
rollout_plan: Phase A (immediate): Run resync job for impacted tenants and push aggregation window guard (console-2026.03-hotfix). Phase B (2 weeks): Deploy producer retry fixes and instrumentation for dropped invalidations. Phase C (1 month): Add end-to-end regression test in e2e-observability harness and implement a control-plane backpressure mechanism for autoscaler bursts.
acceptance_criteria:
- Resync job reduces missing-series incidents by >95% for reproducer workload.
- No customer reports of missing per-route gauges in the next 7 days post-hotfix.
- New regression test passes in CI and simulates autoscaler churn with no metric silence.
- Metrics showing dropped invalidations fall to near zero after producer changes.
